row.headline: $150M BYD EV Assembly Plant Launch in Sindh Delayed Again
row.summary: Hub Power Company (Hubco) has officially pushed back the launch of its BYD EV assembly plant in Gharo, Sindh, aiming to bring the plant online in the second half of 2026.
